findings.evidence: Lines 42–132 and 171–173 contain no fundamental-groupoid declarations; the first use of `fundamentalGroupoidFunctor` is `cechDiagram` at line 135.
findings.fix: Move the generic index, intersection, open/TopCat diagrams, inclusions, and cover lemma to an earlier topology module such as `TauCeti/Topology/Category/TopCat/CechDiagram.lean`; have this file import it and retain only `cechDiagram`, `cechCocone`, and their groupoid lemmas.
findings.issue: `CechIndex` through `cechInclusionNatTrans_app` (and the cover lemma at line 171) use only finite sets, opens, and TopCat, yet live under `TauCeti.FundamentalGroupoid`; this makes a broadly useful topological Čech diagram depend conceptually on later algebraic-topology theory.

summary: The fundamental-groupoid specialization is well placed, but the reusable open-set and TopCat Čech construction is buried in that downstream module and namespace.
